name: codex
description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

full_access.title: Full access for Codex jobs
full_access.description: When true, Codex tasks run with sandbox=danger-full-access and approvalPolicy=never: no confirmation prompts, writes outside the workspace, loopback network and process control. Equivalent to passing --full-access. Default false keeps the current read-only/workspace-write behavior.

incident_log.title: Incident log path
incident_log.description: Optional markdown file. Every blocked approval, failed command, timeout, or killed process appends one entry. Equivalent to --incident-log <path> or CODEX_COMPANION_INCIDENT_LOG.
